blocking.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
blocking.text: A step that other persons can see, but that you can undo, has no risk of this type.
blocking.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/ste-rules.md line 113, the rule "Write a condition at the start of that step" is applicable to a step that has no risk, but its heading "Before a step with a risk" (line 109) gives only the condition of a step with a risk.
blocking.correction: Move the line 113 rule to a new section after the last section, with the heading "When you write a step that other persons can see", and keep its text: "A step that other persons can see, but that you can undo, has no risk of this type. advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: A name counts as its number of words, for example "Claude Code" counts as 2 words. This rule is stricter than rule 8.6, which counts a name as 1 word.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/ste-rules.md line 84, the rule does not obey rule 8.6 of the standard, which is not usual for the agent, and the text gives no cause for the stricter count.
advisory.correction: "A name counts as its number of words, for example "Claude Code" counts as 2 words. This rule is stricter than rule 8.6, which counts a name as 1 word, because <the cause from the author or the user>." If no file and no user gives the cause, add a warning.
